workflows.task: inspect suspected moisture in a wall
workflows.problem: suspected water intrusion or elevated wall moisture

affordance.purpose: measure or compare moisture condition in building material
affordance.orientation: meter face or appropriate probe against wall
affordance.human_action: press or hold the moisture meter against the wall while reading the measurement

workflows.human_action: measure the affected wall area and document the reading
workflows.environment: interior building inspection or restoration site
must: person visibly reads or documents measurement
must_not: holographic moisture effect as the measurement

workflows.problem: establish room geometry for construction or renovation

affordance.purpose: measure straight-line distance to a selected target
affordance.orientation: aimed at a wall or corner target
affordance.human_action: aim the laser distance meter toward the opposite wall while taking the measurement
evidence: device aimed at wall or corner

workflows.human_action: measure distance from one side of the room to the opposite wall
must: device is connected to a plausible target
must_not: laser meter used like thermal camera

workflows.task: measure a door or window opening
workflows.problem: document opening dimensions for installation or replacement
workflows.tool: laser distance meter or measuring tape

affordance.orientation: aligned with the dimension being measured
affordance.human_action: align the measuring tool with the opening and take the dimension

workflows.problem: assess visible cracking during quality control

affordance.purpose: observe or compare crack width or condition
affordance.human_action: inspect the crack closely and document its condition

workflows.human_action: closely inspect and document the concrete crack
must: tool and crack occupy the same meaningful area

workflows.problem: identify embedded reinforcement before drilling or structural assessment

affordance.purpose: locate embedded reinforcement and estimate position or depth
affordance.orientation: sensor area against surface and moved across scan area
affordance.human_action: move the scanner across the concrete surface while monitoring the display

workflows.human_action: scan the concrete surface systematically while monitoring the scanner display

affordance.purpose: measure or estimate reinforcement position and cover depth
affordance.orientation: sensor maintained against surface during scanning
affordance.human_action: scan the surface while recording cover or depth information

workflows.human_action: scan the concrete surface and record reinforcement cover information
must_not: unsupported claim of seeing through concrete without scanning

workflows.task: inspect building conditions with thermal imaging
workflows.problem: investigate temperature patterns related to moisture, air leakage, insulation or systems

affordance.purpose: capture infrared temperature patterns from a target
affordance.human_action: aim the thermal camera at the target while interpreting the display

workflows.human_action: scan the building surface or system with a thermal camera and interpret the display
must_not: thermal colors painted on real wall as naked-eye evidence

workflows.problem: verify level or elevation during construction or fit-out

affordance.purpose: establish or compare a reference level
affordance.orientation: instrument stabilized according to measurement method
affordance.human_action: position the instrument and observe the reference level

workflows.human_action: establish a level reference and compare floor elevation
must_not: floating level line with no source or target

workflows.problem: document surface defects, finish quality or maintenance condition
workflows.tool: inspection light, camera, or surface gauge

affordance.purpose: illuminate, observe, photograph or compare surface condition
affordance.human_action: inspect the surface closely and document the condition

workflows.human_action: inspect and document concrete surface condition

workflows.problem: identify and document a specific site safety condition
workflows.tool: inspection checklist, tablet, camera, or task-appropriate measurement device

affordance.purpose: observe and document a specific site condition
affordance.human_action: inspect the condition and record observations

workflows.human_action: inspect a specific site condition and document the finding
must: inspection has a specific observable subject
must_not: random PPE with no work context
